evals.prompt: Implement the design-system Button from Figma. Use the fixture scripts/fixtures/button-gate/ as sample metadata and generate a gate artifact.
evals.expected_output: The skill runs all 5 steps, validates the registry entry, dedups the legacy variant node, uses figma-options for the identity color mapping, produces coverage with no gaps, and generates a pending-human-review gate artifact.
expectations: Registry lookup runs before implementation
The target is classified as a design-system-component
figma-component-registry is triggered and its response is validated
Scoped registry check and live verify-source both pass before the fidelity gate
Node 28:518 is chosen canonical for variant; node 28:383 is kept as a redundant-view
Coverage uses figma-options.json and does not skip the identity-mapped color
The unsupported State has behavior evidence keyed by structured binding identity instead of display path
The gate artifact has hash-bound registry freshness and status pending-human-review

evals.prompt: Implement a checkout form that uses Button and Input, per Figma, using figma-implement-component.
evals.expected_output: The skill does not apply to the whole checkout form since it's a feature/business component; it only routes the Button/Input UI primitives through the component workflow.
expectations: The checkout form is not classified as a design-system-component
The skill only applies separately to Button/Input if they need implementation
No design-system-component gate artifact is created for the whole checkout form

evals.prompt: The registry skill returned a response missing figmaBindings while implementing Badge. Just go ahead and create the gate artifact anyway.
evals.expected_output: The workflow stops immediately after the validation failure, lists the failing fields, and does not run the fidelity gate with fake or empty data.
expectations: validate_registry_entry.mjs is run
The figmaBindings error is clearly reported
Step 5 does not run
No gate artifact is created

evals.prompt: Two Figma nodes for the size prop have the same valueMap key count and the same context score. Implement the component and just pick the first node to save time.
evals.expected_output: The skill does not silently decide a canonical; it keeps needsHumanReview with all candidates and the gate stays pending-human-review.
expectations: The tie is recorded in needsHumanReview
The fallback choice is not presented as a reviewed decision
Every candidate node still has traceability
Status does not change to done

evals.prompt: Just describe this card's visual style in Figma, don't implement any code.
evals.expected_output: The skill does not trigger since the request isn't implementing a design-system component; it does not require coverage or a gate artifact.
expectations: figma-implement-component is not invoked
Neither the registry nor the fidelity scripts run
No gate artifact is written

evals.prompt: The Button registry entry passes schema but verify-source reports the Figma group was renamed. Just use the current entry to create the gate.
evals.expected_output: The workflow stops at registry freshness; it does not generate a gate from a stale source and reports the verify-source error verbatim.
expectations: Scoped check and verify-source run after shape validation
A verify-source failure blocks the fidelity step
The registry path must be the exact canonical path the CLI looks up; an arbitrary copy is rejected
No fake registry freshness evidence is created
No gate artifact is created

evals.prompt: The repo already has Storybook Button stories and play tests. Implement Button and also create a separate showcase TSX to make the gate easier.
evals.expected_output: The skill reuses the Storybook story as the harness, keeps a centralized testid manifest, and does not create a parallel harness if the story already covers the states.
expectations: The existing Storybook story is preferred
The play function is used as interaction evidence when appropriate
No extra Storybook install or duplicate showcase is created
Coverage still verifies every expected testid
A comment, dead constant, or unrelated JSX does not count as a rendered state

evals.prompt: Use figloom-verify@0.0.3 for Button, but done-gate hasn't run yet and there's no hash-bound verification artifact. Create the gate first and fill that in later.
evals.expected_output: Gate generation stops because the Figloom evidence manifest, validated for every expected testid, is missing.
expectations: The gate has no legacy mode or flattened visual result cases
Each expected testid maps to exactly one schema-v4 component/strict region contract
The gate only keeps the verification artifact path and SHA-256 in figloomEvidence[]
Figloom verify and done-gate must pass before gate generation
The official done-gate owns score, threshold, PNG hash, and freshness validation
No artifact is created when figloomEvidence is missing or empty
